title: KILLER FRUITS STRAW GUAW VAPETASIA TFN E-JUICE 100ML
description:
Straw Guaw 100 ml by Vapetasia Synthetic offers you a delightful blend of juicy strawberry, exotic guava, and tasty watermelon. These flavors work together, giving you snippets of each flavor in harmony. You will enjoy every moment, which will leave you pleasantly surprised, as the taste has been perfected in every way possible. It will make your taste buds dance between sweet strawberries, exotic guava, and juicy watermelon.
*This flavor contains tobacco-free nicotine, a synthetic nicotine that is not extracted from tobacco leaves.
